picks.editorial_note: UW is leading and supporting four projects under DOE's new Genesis Mission, a 300+ institution national initiative to accelerate scientific discovery with AI — one of the broadest coordinated pushes yet to embed AI infrastructure directly into the federal research enterprise.
picks.title: UW researchers lead and support new ‘AI-for-Science’ Genesis Mission awards | UW News

picks.editorial_note: Brookhaven's $14.2M Genesis Mission award, with Stony Brook as a partner, will build a foundation model for the U.S. electric grid — a concrete example of AI-for-science funding aimed at critical infrastructure the entire AI boom depends on.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million gift establishing a dedicated AI and analytics college at UNT signals growing private investment in building out AI-focused academic infrastructure at scale.
picks.title: UNT receives $20 million gift to advance artificial intelligence, advanced analytics

picks.editorial_note: A $10 million OpenAI Foundation grant (part of a $60M investment) to bring AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers is a rare example of AI research funding translating directly into real-world humanitarian impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's rollout of ChatGPT Edu to over 80,000 students and staff is one of the largest AI-in-education deployments in the Asia-Pacific region, marking a major industry-academia partnership shaping how a generation learns.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for DOE's 'Mine of the Future' initiative reflects growing federal interest in applying AI to critical minerals and industrial infrastructure, with direct policy implications for domestic supply chains.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: USF's unveiling of its new Bellini College of AI, Cybersecurity and Computing building, backed by a $40 million gift, illustrates the scale of capital being committed to dedicated AI education infrastructure.
picks.title: USF President Limayem announces location, unveils plans for new Bellini College building

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim to have solved a Millennium Prize math problem — met with public skepticism from UCLA's Terence Tao — is a high-stakes test case for how AI capability claims in fundamental mathematics get scrutinized by the research community.
picks.title: OpenAI says it has solved one of math’s 'Millennium Problems' — and more UCLA media

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's InstructMesh, developed with Google and Northeastern, lets users repair and fabricate AI-generated 3D models reliably — addressing a persistent gap between generative design and real-world manufacturing.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's ETCRAM analog memory technology achieves 100x efficiency gains over conventional approaches, a hardware breakthrough that could meaningfully ease the energy demands of AI-capable devices.
picks.title: New analog memory may make smart devices even smarter
